title: Purchase Order — a commitment to a supplier
description: The buying cycle's mirror of the sales order: a commitment made to a supplier, fulfilled by a purchase receipt. The field names follow the buying side's convention (supplier, expected_delivery) rather than reusing the selling names, because the two cycles are read by different people and the upstream surface keeps them distinct.

expected_delivery.description: The date the supplier is expected to deliver against, which the receipt is measured against.

supplier.description: Link to the supplier party. Named 'supplier' rather than 'party' so the buying documents read the way the buying cycle speaks.

supplier_quotation.description: The supplier quotation this order was raised from, when it was.

harvest: the purchase order field surface (supplier, expected_delivery, supplier quotation link, taxes, totals)
the buying convention of naming the party field for the side of the trade
the state set the buying cycle drives an order through
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream purchase order doctype, re-expressed. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
